mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in easing periods but not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 4%, indicating a weakening labor market, this triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the following 5 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and investment.
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses 4% but 20d returns remain positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) proxies indicate expanding economic activity, which positively impacts equity valuations and S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and HOUST rise but returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or interaction effect not present.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated discount rates on equities compress returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rise but returns remain positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO (supply) above 102.5 suggests robust production growth, boosting corporate profits and S&P 500 returns by 5 days as market anticipates sustained supply-driven growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses 102.5 but returns not positive or not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS (employment) alongside falling UNRATE (unemployment) signals labor market recovery, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS up and UNRATE down but returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or interaction effect not present.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (demand) reflects expanding economic output, which enhances corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 trends upward but returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) proxies amplify growth signals, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as markets anticipate sustained momentum.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise in late-cycle but returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or interaction effect not significant.
